hotspots.title: Wiki Button
hotspots.body: Access this in-game wiki anytime with this button

hotspots.title: Live Controller Mode
hotspots.body: Control redstone signals or peripheral links with your keyboard or gamepad! This mode has a lot of parts to it. I do my best in the Live Controller page to explain it clearly, but ask if you need help setting up what you want!

hotspots.title: Sequencer Mode
hotspots.body: Visual scripting mode-- there's so much you can do with it! This is my attempt to make the amazing features of CC:Tweaked / Aeronautics integration accessible for more people. Again, ask me if you need help. Especially because the wiki is not started for this mode yet. It will take the longest.

hotspots.title: Setup Menu
hotspots.body: Submenu area for wireless and other setup features. See the "Setup Menu" page to get familiar with that UI

hotspots.title: Other modes
hotspots.body: Submenu area for all other features. See the "Misc" page to learn more. These modes were the part of the first versions of this mod, so I haven't refined them. The Sequencer and Live Controller have really taken over as the stars of the show.
